description: Get Subframe's guidance for designing motion well, by topic: principles (whether to animate at all), timing (durations, curves, springs), enter-exit (menus, dialogs, toasts), feedback (hover, press, state, loading), scroll, ambient (loops, backgrounds, shaders), text-and-numbers, performance, accessibility and adapting (turning a library example into project code). Read the relevant topics before designing, adapting or reviewing any animation, not only library examples.
name: get_motion_guidance
title: Get Motion Guidance
